name: Formal Definition of Knot-Class Invariant (T_class)
statement: A knot-class invariant is a discrete topological descriptor derived from the persistence homology of a process realization.
formal_representation: b_0 is the zeroth Betti number (connected components)
b_1 is the first Betti number (independent cycles/holes)

operational_mapping.notes: The invariant T is extracted via persistence landscape analysis.
